messages.content: I need to finish the Wednesday-to-Thursday logistics for Raleigh. First confirm whether the Hampton will hold my suitcase after checkout while I am at the closing meeting.

The Hampton Inn & Suites Holly Springs confirmed that registered guests may leave luggage with the front desk after Wednesday checkout at no charge. They will tag the suitcase and provide a claim ticket; valuables should stay with you.
Good. The meeting is expected to end at 5:30 p.m., but allow for it to run 30 minutes late. What time should I plan to leave for RDU, return the rental, and get to the Hyatt Place?

Planning from a 6:00 p.m. departure, allow about 35-50 minutes to RDU in evening traffic, 15-25 minutes for fuel and the rental return, and another 15-25 minutes for the Hyatt pickup after you call. A realistic Hyatt arrival is 7:15-7:40 p.m. I would put 6:00 p.m. on the schedule and avoid committing to anything before 8:00 p.m.
That works. Reserve the 4:55 a.m. Hyatt shuttle for Thursday, rather than leaving it as a request. Also make sure the late-arrival note does not still say 10:30 p.m.

The Hyatt Place has confirmed one seat on the 4:55 a.m. Thursday airport shuttle. The reservation is under Priya Nair, and they recommend being in the lobby by 4:45 a.m. I also changed the arrival note to approximately 7:15-7:40 p.m., with a possible later arrival if the closing meeting runs beyond 6:00.
Please put both hotel addresses and the transportation confirmations into the schedule. Include checkout, bag pickup, rental return, hotel pickup, and Thursday departure.

The trip schedule now shows: Wednesday checkout from Hampton Inn & Suites Holly Springs, 1050 S Main St, Holly Springs, NC 27540; leave the tagged suitcase at the front desk, then reclaim it after the closing meeting. Depart the site area at 6:00 p.m., fuel and return the midsize rental at RDU around 6:45-7:05 p.m., then call Hyatt Place Raleigh-Durham Airport for pickup after the return is complete. Hyatt address: 200 Airgate Dr, Morrisville, NC 27560. Expected hotel arrival is 7:15-7:40 p.m. Thursday: report to the lobby at 4:45 a.m. for the confirmed 4:55 shuttle, ahead of the 7:15 a.m. nonstop to SFO. The Hampton luggage hold, revised Hyatt arrival note, airport pickup procedure, and timed shuttle reservation are all recorded.
